```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(SeuratDisk)
```

# Load the dataset and create a Seurat Object
```{r}
f1_dir <- 'E:/HLHS/data/P0116/filtered_feature_bc_matrix'
f1.data <- Read10X(data.dir = f1_dir)
f1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = f1.data)
f1$sample <- "P0116"
```

```{r}
sample[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sample, pattern = "^MT-")
```

```{r}
sample
```

```{r}
png(filename="./pre qc violin plot.png", width=18, height=10, units="cm", res=300)
VlnPlot(sample, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
sample$sample <- factor(x = sample$sample, levels = c('P0156', 'P0318', 'P0172', 'P0202', 'P0344', 'P0219', 'P0254', 'T1126', 'T1197', 'P0116', 'T1093', 'T1007', 'P0371', 'T485'))
```

```{r}
png(filename="./pre qc violin plot nFeature_RNA.png", width=25, height=10, units="cm", res=300)
VlnPlot(sample, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), group.by = "sample", pt.size = 0)+ NoLegend()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
png(filename="./pre qc violin plot nCount_RNA.png", width=25, height=10, units="cm", res=300)
VlnPlot(sample, features = c("nCount_RNA"), group.by = "sample", pt.size = 0)+ NoLegend()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
png(filename="./pre qc violin plot percent.mt.png", width=25, height=10, units="cm", res=300)
VlnPlot(sample, features = c("percent.mt"), group.by = "sample", pt.size = 0)+ NoLegend()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
sample_filtered <- subset(sample, subset = nCount_RNA > 1000 & nCount_RNA < 10000 & percent.mt < 5)
```

```{r}
sample_filtered
```

```{r}
png(filename="./post qc violin plot.png", width = 18, height = 10, units = "cm", res = 300)
VlnPlot(sample_filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
png(filename="./post qc violin plot nFeature_RNA.png", width=25, height=10, units="cm", res=300)

dev.off()
```


```{r}

```

```{r}
SaveH5Seurat(sample_filtered, filename = "./scrublet step/merged_postQC.h5Seurat")
```

```{r}
Convert("./scrublet step/merged_postQC.h5Seurat", dest = "h5ad")
```


```{r}
#### Load in doublet output
scrub = read.csv('./scrublet step/scrublet-scores/all.csv',header=T,row.names=1)
```

```{r}
sample_filtered@meta.data$scrublet_score = scrub$scrublet_score
sample_filtered@meta.data$scrublet_cluster_score = scrub$scrublet_cluster_score
sample_filtered@meta.data$bh_pval = scrub$bh_pval
```

```{r}
sample_filtered$sample <- factor(x = sample_filtered$sample, levels = c('P0156', 'P0318', 'P0172', 'P0202', 'P0344', 'P0219', 'P0254', 'T1126', 'T1197', 'P0116', 'T1093', 'T1007', 'P0371', 'T485'))
```


```{r}
png(filename="./scrublet sample violin plot.png", width = 25, height = 10, units = "cm", res = 300)
VlnPlot(sample_filtered, group.by = "sample", features = "scrublet_score", pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
sample_filtered
```

```{r}
sample_filtered2 <- subset(
  x = sample_filtered,
  subset = scrublet_score < 0.25
)
```

```{r}
sample_filtered2
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(sample_filtered2, group.by = "sample", features = "scrublet_score", pt.size = 0) + NoLegend()
```

```{r}
rm(sample)
rm(sample_filtered)
gc()
```


```{r}
saveRDS(sample_filtered2, "./merged_postQC_doubletRemoval.rds")
```
